annotations.text:
Direction A · “Daylight” — the working day as a strip of light.
Green is only ever spare time. Blue = other people's meetings. Dark = blocks you chose. Amber = gently over. Ember appears only for a real deadline.
Type: Instrument Serif (the numbers), Instrument Sans (UI), DM Mono (times).
Static mockups — nothing is clickable yet.
The spare-time ribbon has three states: spare (green), fits exactly (grey), over (amber with a soft tail). Never red, never a count of overdue tasks.
Two low-fi alternates in case Daylight isn't it. Pick one and I'll rebuild the whole set in that direction.
